server.scope: short synthetic lifecycle exercise; forced round transitions, no rewards

limits: End-of-run empty temporary/binding dictionaries are asserted by fixture but their raw counts are not emitted.
Ten reservations remain within the source-defined 60 simulation-second expiry window.
Six memory samples over 64 simulation seconds do not establish leak freedom.

first_ack_bounds.method: Last server occupancy precedes the report callback wall-time read. Therefore first positive ACK sample A is no later than report.wall_elapsed_seconds+(A.msec-last_occupancy.msec)/1000. Subtract nominal close time; actual close is at or after that time. Bounds apply only to emitted final bindings and do not measure client ACK delivery.
